ordered_diagnoses: Intraductal Papillary Mucinous Neoplasm of the Liver

frontier_selector.why: The presence of a well-defined, low-density, heterogeneous, multilocular cystic tumor with septa and an enhancing solid compartment on abdominal CT, along with PET–CT showing FDG uptake in the solid components of the cyst, decided it.

support_spans: Abdominal CT revealed a well-defined, low-density, heterogeneous, multilocular cystic tumor
MRI showed mixed high and low signal intensity
PET–CT showed FDG uptake in the solid components of the cyst

registry.preferred_label: Intraductal Papillary Mucinous Neoplasm of the Liver
support_spans: DUPAN-2 was 200 U/mL, CA125 was 321.8 U/mL, and neuron-specific enolase was 29.2 ng/mL
contradict_spans: mucinous cystadenocarcinoma or sarcoma of the liver
Tests for hepatitis B and C viral markers were negative
